assertions: Original default/handler/size/scalar-fill/range/copy/clone/move constructors preserve member initialization, zero-size early return, exact range-size diagnostics and ordered acquired callbacks using genuine shared blocks and metadata.

Original copy and move assignments create a temporary, swap and destroy it even on self assignment. Event copy/move/swap witnesses preserve original handler values and stable borrowed event field references.
Original move transfers vectors without resetting the primitive source logical size; size, block_size and empty keep their distinct original contracts.
Original destructor and clear release each nonnull block before registered deletion and pointer nulling, in source order. Clear resets arrays and logical size only afterward.
Original full swap, default block shrink, self/size/store equality and all mutable/const forward/reverse endpoint factories reuse the existing actual shared ownership and iterator modules.

stackDivergence.rationale: Actual original container field/lifetime owner reuses existing shared blocks, metadata and iterators; explicit C++ syntax witnesses introduce no alternative storage engine.

record.capability: Shared original SoA container constructor and lifetime ownership
gaps: Scope is the original constructor/lifetime/operator/iterator-endpoint group on the selected libc++ host, default execution and no_trace, with initialized unmanaged all12 scalar families and nonthrowing event value witnesses. Native event copy/move/swap operations, scalar overloads and explicit dispose adapt erased C++ syntax; swap exchanges event field contents while preserving borrowed object identity. Compound inputs are prepared using original public set in the native caller and loaded as complete native fixtures in tests; segment set is not ported or certified.
